mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (current level: 0.08%) indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 0.25% within the last 30 days signals imminent monetary tightening, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in last 30 days
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in last 30 days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeds 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% within the last 30 days, it signals a tightening cycle that historically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 5.0% AND FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in last 30 days
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 5.0% AND FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in last 30 days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to cut rates to stimulate the economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1600 indicates weak demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102.5, it signals a slowdown in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102.5 and housing starts (HOUST) are below 1600, it signals a simultaneous slowdown in supply and demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 102.5 AND HOUST falls below 1600
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.5 AND HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 5.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%)
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25% AND CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
